name: AWS Account Bootstrap
description: One-time AWS account setup that creates the GitHub OIDC trust and deploy roles used by GitHub Actions.

name: PR Checks
description: Pull request validation workflow for main. Runs secret scanning, frontend validation, backend tests, and Terraform formatting/validation before changes are merged.
steps: Frontend install, lint, tests, and build

name: Deploy Staging
description: Continuous staging deployment workflow. On pushes to main or manual dispatch, it validates the repo, packages frontend and Lambda artifacts, applies the staging Terraform stack, and invalidates CloudFront.
trigger: push to main or manual dispatch

name: Release Production
description: Manual production-class release workflow. It can run Terraform plan or apply for either the production stack or the disaster-recovery stack.
outputs: Terraform plan artifact for plan runs
Production AWS resources for production apply
DR AWS resources for disaster-recovery apply
errored.tfstate artifact when Terraform cannot persist state

name: Release Artifact Packaging
description: Builds React frontend assets, prerenders storefront content when required, and packages Lambda artifacts for Terraform deployment.

name: Terraform App Stack Deploy
description: Initializes Terraform with the target backend, validates required runtime SSM parameters, runs plan or apply with the selected tfvars file, and optionally invalidates CloudFront after apply.
